summary: Assess complete. All three gaps grounded at file+line before exit criteria were written. Grounding corrected four SPECIFICATION.md citations and split GAP-03 into an ordered pair: no tenant concept exists in src/ (tenant_id absent everywhere; UserClaims is {sub,name,roles,exp}), so partitioning must be preceded by introducing the claim, which itself depends on GAP-02's verifier. Execution order is therefore load-bearing. Also surfaced an unrecorded live defect: jwt_required hardcoded false at middleware.rs:85, making both the absent-token and invalid-token branches fall through to anonymous. Two open questions for the operator (OQ-1 fix-the-bypass-here, OQ-2 tenant claim provenance); neither blocks analyze.
